title: 第十五章 幽谷白蟒 灵蛇劫杀第十六章 废仓鼠魅 群妖噬祸
content_zh:
辞荒庙清雾，度鬼母怨魂，四神踏晨辉复向西行。历经前番七重劫难，斩妖除魔无数，救济苍生万千，青龙、玄武、朱雀、白虎四象神力已然交融，心意相通，举手投足间皆有正道灵光内敛，道心历经万般磨砺，愈发澄澈如镜，不为外邪所扰，只为早日平定天下灾厄，不负苍生所盼。
一路西行，渐入连绵群山，山势险峻，峰峦入云，古木参天，荫蔽天日。林间雾气氤氲，湿寒入骨，草木葱郁间，却无鸟兽啼鸣，死寂沉沉，唯有山风穿林，发出呜咽之声，透着一股难言的诡异与清冷。
行至正午，日头高悬，林间雾气非但未曾散去，反倒愈发浓重，白茫茫一片，遮天蔽日，五步之外难辨人影。风中隐隐传来丝丝腥甜之气，不同于先前蛇精的浊臭，此气清冷阴柔，却暗藏凛冽杀意，萦绕鼻尖，令人心神微凛。
张忠东手持火焰灵杖，眉头紧蹙，周身圣火隐隐流转，沉声开口：“此地雾气阴寒，腥气暗藏，死寂无生，必有灵妖盘踞，且道行不浅，绝非寻常山野精怪可比。”
王学南驻足凝神，指尖掐动卦诀，推演天地气机，片刻之后，面色骤然沉凝，缓缓叹道：“此卦显阴，主灵妖作祟，卦象直指前方白蟒谷，谷中有一千年白蛇妖，吸纳山川清灵气与日月精华修行，道行深厚，法力高强，性情阴鸷，盘踞谷中多年，残害过往行人，覆灭周边村落，致使此地荒寂无人，生灵绝迹。”
宁洋北催动青木灵气，穿透浓雾探向谷中，灵气所及，只觉谷中阴气与灵气交织，一股庞大而阴冷的妖力盘踞核心，周遭草木尽皆沾染妖力，看似葱郁，实则暗藏杀机，更有无数亡魂怨气萦绕，皆是被白蛇妖所害的乡民与修士。他收敛灵气，神色肃然道：“此妖乃千年白蟒化形，修得一身冰寒妖法，能吐雾凝霜、布冰锁魂，谷中浓雾便是它布下的妖阵，误入者皆会迷失其中，沦为它腹中之食。我等西行之路，必经此谷，别无他径，唯有入谷斩妖，平息此劫。”
陈学西腰间白虎利刃嗡鸣作响，寒芒暗透鞘身，眸光冷冽扫过茫茫浓雾，沉声道：“既无他路，便直入幽谷，斩除妖邪，打通西行通途。”
四人心意既定，不再多言，并肩踏入浓雾之中。雾气沾身，阴寒刺骨，仿若冰刃刮肤，灵气稍弱便会被寒气侵入肌理，冻损经脉。四神各自运转本命灵气，青龙生机、玄武厚重、朱雀纯阳、白虎肃杀，四道灵光交织成罩，抵御寒雾侵袭，稳步向着谷中前行。
行约半个时辰，浓雾渐散，眼前豁然开朗，一座幽深幽谷显现眼前。谷中溪水潺潺，草木繁盛，看似清幽雅致，实则遍地冰霜，寒气逼人，溪面凝结厚冰，草木覆满白霜，处处透着死寂。谷中深处，一座寒冰洞府矗立，洞口寒气弥漫，白雾缭绕，正是那千年白蛇妖的修行居所。
洞府之前，横七竖八散落着累累白骨，有乡民骸骨，亦有修士残躯，白骨之上覆着薄冰，早已被冻得坚硬如石，怨气与寒气交织，令人望之生畏。
便在此时，一阵清冷柔媚的笑声，自洞府中缓缓传出，笑声婉转悠扬，却带着蚀骨的阴寒，穿透空气，萦绕在幽谷之中，听得人心神恍惚，极易被其蛊惑。
“四位远道而来的小仙长，闯入我这白蟒幽谷，是想给我送些点心，还是专程来送性命的？”
笑声落罢，一道白衣身影自寒冰洞府中缓步走出，身姿曼妙，步履轻盈，周身萦绕着清冷白雾与淡淡灵光，容颜绝世，眉目如画，肌肤胜雪，宛若九天仙子降临凡尘，一身白衣胜雪，不染尘埃，唯有一双眼眸，清冷如冰，泛着幽幽寒芒，暗藏妖异与杀意。
此女便是盘踞白蟒谷的千年白蛇妖，化为人形，名唤白泠，修得一身通天彻地的冰寒妖法，在谷中独霸一方，残害无数生灵。
白泠立于寒冰石阶之上，居高临下，眸光淡漠地扫过四神，柔声开口，语气看似温婉，却字字带刺：“我这幽谷，多年未有生人闯入，你们倒是胆大，竟敢径直闯入我的地界，就不怕有来无回，化作这谷中一堆白骨吗？”
宁洋北上前一步，神色凛然，厉声斥道：“你这白蛇妖，修行千年，本该吸纳天地灵气，潜心向善，修成正果，却偏偏盘踞幽谷，兴风作浪，残害无辜乡民，屠戮过往修士，造下无边杀孽，致使此地荒寂，怨气冲天。今日我等奉天命西行救世，途经此地，定要斩你这妖邪，超度万千亡魂，还此地一方安宁！”
白泠闻言，非但不惧，反倒掩唇轻笑，笑声中满是不屑与嘲讽：“斩我？就凭你们四个毛头仙长？我修行千年，历经无数劫难，等闲神仙都未必是我的对手，就凭你们，也敢口出狂言。天地万物，本就是弱肉强食，那些凡人与修士，修为浅薄，沦为我的腹中餐，不过是顺应天道，何来罪孽之说？”
“妖言惑众！”张忠东怒火中烧，圣火灵杖直指白蛇妖，厉声喝道，“天地生灵，皆有生存之权，你为一己修行，肆意屠戮无辜，违背天道伦常，实属罪大恶极。今日我便以纯阳圣火，焚尽你这妖邪，为万千亡魂报仇雪恨！”
白泠眸光微冷，脸上笑意瞬间散去，取而代之的是凛冽杀意：“既然你们执意找死，那我便成全你们。正好，我许久未曾吞食仙门修士的魂魄与灵气，今日便拿你们四人，滋补我的修行，助我突破妖力瓶颈！”
话音未落，白泠身形一闪，化作一道白色残影，速度快如闪电，周身寒气暴涨，幽谷之中瞬间狂风大作，冰霜骤起，无数冰针自空气中凝聚而成，密密麻麻，带着凛冽寒气，直奔四神而去。冰针坚硬无比，且蕴含剧毒寒气，一旦沾身，便会冰封经脉，冻僵神魂。

陈学西率先出手，白虎利刃应声出鞘，寒光彻骨，杀伐之气席卷全场。他身形化作一道白光，穿梭于冰针之间，利刃挥舞，寒光纵横，每一击都精准劈碎冰针，金铁交鸣之声不绝于耳，碎冰四溅，散落一地。
“诸位小心，此妖冰寒之力，能冰封灵气，切勿被寒气近身！”陈学西沉声提醒，脚下步法灵动，直逼白蛇妖身前，利刃直刺其要害，招式凌厉，不留分毫余地。
白泠冷笑一声，衣袖挥动，寒气凝聚成一道厚重冰墙，挡在身前，白虎利刃劈在冰墙之上，虽破开裂痕，却未能彻底击碎，反被寒气反噬，利刃之上覆上一层薄冰。
与此同时，张忠东催动朱雀圣火，灵杖挥舞，滔天纯阳圣火席卷而出，化作熊熊火浪，直奔白蛇妖扑去。圣火至阳至刚，专克阴寒妖邪，与冰寒之气相撞，瞬间发出滋滋声响，白雾蒸腾，寒气与圣火相互抗衡，一时之间难分高下。
“区区圣火，也想破我的冰寒妖法，太过天真！”白泠冷喝一声，双手结印，口中念动妖诀，幽谷地底寒气尽数被引动，地面之上瞬间凝结出厚厚的冰层，无数冰藤破土而出，带着尖锐冰刺，缠绕向四神，欲将其牢牢冰封。
宁洋北见状，青木灵气轰然爆发，生机之力弥漫全场，青绿色灵光化作无数粗壮青藤，破土而出，与冰藤相互缠绕，生机之力化解冰寒戾气，牢牢牵制住冰藤攻势。“玄武守阵，护住周身，切勿被寒气侵入！”宁洋北高声传令，青木灵气源源不断滋养三人，抵御冰寒侵袭。
王学南即刻撑开玄武灵伞，淡青色灵光暴涨，化作一道坚不可摧的防御屏障，笼罩四神周身，抵挡四面八方袭来的冰刃与寒气。冰层与冰藤撞击在屏障之上，发出轰然巨响，灵光震颤，却始终稳固不破，玄武守御之力，尽显无余。
一时间，幽谷之中，冰寒与圣火碰撞，青藤与冰藤纠缠，杀伐之气与阴寒妖力交织，狂风呼啸，冰霜漫天，圣火熊熊，灵光闪耀，一场惊天动地的正邪大战，彻底爆发。
白蛇妖身形飘忽不定，在冰雾之中穿梭自如，冰寒妖法层出不穷，时而凝聚冰剑劈砍，时而吐纳寒雾冰封，时而操控冰棱突袭，招式阴柔狠辣，招招直取四神要害。她修行千年，妖力深厚，对冰系法术的掌控已然登峰造极，幽谷便是她的主场，借助地脉寒气，实力更增数倍。
四神联手应战，进退有度，攻守相依。宁洋北以青木生机化解寒气、稳固阵脚，王学南以玄武守御抵挡攻击、庇护众人，张忠东以朱雀圣火强攻妖身、压制阴寒，陈学西以白虎杀伐直击要害、斩破妖法，四象神力相辅相成，环环相扣，与白蛇妖激战数百回合，依旧不分胜负。
content_en:
The clear mist of Cihuang Temple saves the resentful soul of the ghost mother, and the four gods step on the morning light and return to the west. After going through the previous seven catastrophes, slaying countless demons and rescuing thousands of people, the divine power of the four elephants of Qinglong, Xuanwu, Suzaku and White Tiger has been integrated, their minds are connected, and the light of the righteous path is restrained in every move and every move. The Taoist heart has gone through all kinds of hardships and become more and more clear like a mirror. It is not disturbed by external evils, but only to put an end to the world's disasters as soon as possible and live up to the expectations of the people.
Traveling westward, we gradually enter the rolling mountains. The mountains are steep and steep, the peaks reach into the clouds, and the ancient trees tower into the sky and shade the sky. The forest was filled with mist, damp and cold, and among the lush vegetation, there were no cries of birds or animals. It was dead silent. Only the mountain wind passed through the forest, making a whimpering sound, which revealed an indescribable strangeness and coldness.
As we walked towards noon, the sun was high in the sky. Instead of dissipating, the fog in the forest became thicker and thicker. A vast expanse of white covered the sky and sun, and it was difficult to identify people five steps away. There was a hint of fishy-sweet smell in the wind, which was different from the turbid smell of the snake essence before. This smell was cold and feminine, but it contained a bit of murderous intent, lingering on the tip of the nose, making people feel slightly chilled.
Zhang Zhongdong held the flaming spiritual staff, frowned, and the holy fire faintly circulated around him, and said in a deep voice: "The fog here is cold, the fishy smell is hidden, and there is no life. There must be spirit demons entrenched, and their Taoism is not shallow, and it is definitely not comparable to ordinary mountain spirits."
Wang Xuenan stopped and concentrated, pinching the hexagram with his fingertips to deduce the qi of heaven and earth. After a moment, his face suddenly became serious, and he sighed slowly: "This hexagram shows yin, and the main spirit demon is causing trouble. The hexagram points directly to the White Python Valley in front. There is a thousand-year white python in the valley. The snake demon absorbs the pure aura of the mountains and rivers and the essence of the sun and moon to practice. It has profound Taoism, strong magical power, and a sinister temperament. It has been entrenched in the valley for many years, killing passers-by and destroying surrounding villages, leaving this place desolate and desolate. "
Ning Yangbei mobilized the green wood spiritual energy and penetrated the dense fog to explore the valley. As far as the spiritual energy could reach, he could only feel the intertwining of Yin Qi and spiritual energy in the valley. A huge and cold demonic power was entrenched in the core. The surrounding vegetation was contaminated with demonic power. It looked lush, but in fact, it hid murderous intent. There were also countless dead souls lingering with resentment, all of which were villagers and monks who were harmed by the white snake demon. He gathered his spiritual energy and said solemnly: "This demon is the form of a thousand-year-old white python. It has mastered the icy demon magic. It can spit out fog and condense frost, and spread ice to lock the soul. The thick fog in the valley is the demon formation it has set up. Anyone who enters by mistake will get lost in it and become its prey. On our way to the west, we must pass through this valley. There is no other way but to enter the valley to kill the demon and quell this disaster."
The sharp white tiger blade on Chen Xuexi's waist buzzed, and the cold light penetrated the sheath. His cold eyes swept through the thick fog, and he said in a deep voice: "Since there is no other way, go straight into the deep valley, kill the evil spirits, and open the way to the west."
The four of them made up their minds, said no more, and stepped into the thick fog side by side. The mist touches the body, and the coldness is biting, like an ice blade scraping the skin. If the spiritual energy is weak, the cold air will invade the texture and freeze the meridians. The four gods each circulate their own spiritual energy, the green dragon is full of vitality, the Xuanwu is thick, the Suzaku is pure Yang, and the White Tiger is sober. The four spiritual lights are intertwined to form a shield, resisting the invasion of cold fog, and moving steadily towards the valley.
After walking for about half an hour, the thick fog gradually dissipated, and suddenly a clear view appeared in front of us, and a deep valley appeared in front of us. The valley has gurgling streams and lush vegetation. It looks quiet and elegant, but in fact it is covered in frost and freezing. Thick ice has condensed on the stream, the vegetation is covered with hoarfrost, and there is a sense of deathly silence everywhere. Deep in the valley, an ice cave stands. The cave entrance is filled with cold air and shrouded in white mist. It is the practice residence of the thousand-year-old white snake demon.
In front of the cave, there are numerous bones scattered everywhere, including the bones of villagers and the remains of monks. The bones are covered with thin ice and have been frozen as hard as stone. The mixture of resentment and cold air makes people look intimidating.
At this moment, a burst of cold and gentle laughter slowly came out from the cave. The laughter was melodious and melodious, but with a bone-crushing coldness, penetrating the air and lingering in the valley. It made people feel dazed and easily bewitched by it.
"Four little immortals who have come from afar have broken into my White Python Valley. Do they want to bring me some snacks, or do they come here specially?Throwing his life? "
After the laughter stopped, a figure in white clothes walked out slowly from the ice cave, with a graceful figure and light steps, surrounded by cold white mist and faint spiritual light. The face was peerless, the features were picturesque, and the skin was better than snow. It was like a fairy from the Nine Heavens descending from the mortal world. He was dressed in white clothes, better than snow, and was not stained by dust. He had only one pair of eyes, as cold as ice, glowing with a faint cold light, hiding evil and murderous intent.
This woman is the thousand-year-old white snake demon who has been entrenched in the White Python Valley. She has transformed into a human form and is named Bai Ling. She has mastered the icy demonic skills that penetrate the heavens and the earth. She dominates the valley and kills countless creatures.
Bai Ling stood on the ice stone steps, condescending, his eyes swept across the four gods indifferently, and spoke softly, his tone seemed gentle, but every word was thorny: "My deep valley, no one has broken into it for many years, but you are so bold that you dare to break into my territory, aren't you afraid that you will never come back and turn into a pile of bones in this valley? "
Ning Yangbei took a step forward, with a stern look on his face, and sternly rebuked: "You, the white snake demon, have been practicing for thousands of years. You should have absorbed the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, devoted yourself to doing good, and achieved righteousness, but instead you have been entrenched in the valley, causing trouble, killing innocent villagers, slaughtering monks in the past, and causing endless crimes, making this place desolate and full of resentment. Today, we are destined to go west to save the world. When passing through this place, we will definitely kill you, the evil spirit, save thousands of dead souls, and restore peace to this place! "
When Bai Ling heard this, not only was he not afraid, but he covered his lips and chuckled, his laughter full of disdain and ridicule: "Kill me? Just because of you four hairy immortals? I have been practicing cultivation for thousands of years and have gone through countless tribulations. Even the gods may not be my opponents, but even you dare to speak arrogantly. All things in the world are meant to be eaten by the weak. Those mortals and monks, with their shallow cultivation, have become my meal. They are just following the way of heaven. How can they be said to be sinful? "
"My lies are deceiving the public! "Zhang Zhongdong was furious. He pointed the holy fire wand directly at the white snake demon and shouted sternly, "All creatures in the world have the right to live. You practice for yourself, wantonly slaughter innocent people, and violate the laws of heaven. It is a heinous crime. Today I will use pure Yang holy fire to burn you evil spirit to avenge thousands of dead souls! "
Bai Ling's eyes were slightly cold, and the smile on his face instantly disappeared, replaced by a murderous intent: "Since you insist on seeking death, then I will help you. It just so happens that I haven't devoured the souls and spiritual energy of the Immortal Sect monks for a long time. Today, I will use the four of you to nourish my practice and help me break through the bottleneck of demonic power! "
Before he finished speaking, Bai Ling's figure flashed and turned into a white afterimage. The speed was as fast as lightning. The cold air around him surged. In the valley, a strong wind instantly blew up. Frost suddenly rose. Countless ice needles condensed from the air. They were densely packed and headed straight for the four gods with a biting cold air. Ice needles are extremely hard and contain highly toxic cold air. Once they touch the body, they will freeze the meridians and freeze the soul.
Chen Xuexi was the first to take action, and the white tiger blade was unsheathed with a sound. The cold light penetrated the bones, and the murderous spirit swept the entire audience. His body turned into a white light, shuttled between the ice needles, waving the sharp blade, and the cold light crisscrossed the ice needles. Every blow accurately shattered the ice needles, the sound of gold and iron clashing could be heard endlessly, and the broken ice splashed everywhere and scattered all over the ground.
“Everyone, be careful, this demon’s ice-cold power can freeze spiritual energy, so don’t let the cold air get close to you! "Chen Xuexi reminded in a deep voice, with agile footwork, he moved directly in front of the white snake demon and stabbed its vitals with a sharp blade. His moves were fierce and left no room for error.
Bai Ling sneered, waving his sleeves, and the cold air condensed into a thick ice wall, blocking it in front of him. The white tiger's sharp blade struck the ice wall. Although it broke the crack, it failed to completely break it. Instead, it was counterattacked by the cold air, and the sharp blade was covered with a thin layer of ice.
At the same time, Zhang Zhongdong activated the Suzaku Holy Fire, waved his spiritual staff, and the pure Yang Holy Fire swept out, turned into a raging wave of fire, and rushed straight towards the White Snake Demon. The holy fire is extremely yang and strong, and is specially designed to overcome the evil spirits of cold and cold. When it collides with the cold air, it instantly makes a sizzling sound, and white mist evaporates. The cold air and the holy fire compete with each other, and it is difficult to distinguish between them for a moment.
"It's just a holy fire, but I want to destroy it."My ice-cold magic method is too naive! "Bai Ling shouted coldly, formed seals with his hands, and chanted the magic spell in his mouth. All the cold air in the valley was aroused, and a thick layer of ice instantly condensed on the ground. Countless ice vines broke out of the ground, carrying sharp ice thorns, entangling the four gods, trying to freeze them firmly.
When Ning Yangbei saw this, the aura of green wood exploded, and the power of vitality filled the whole place. The green aura turned into countless thick ivy, broke out of the ground, and intertwined with the ice vines. The power of vitality dissolved the cold and violent energy, and firmly contained the ice vine offensive. "Xuanwu defends the formation and protects the whole body from being invaded by the cold air! "Ning Yangbei shouted the order, and the green wood spiritual energy continuously nourished the three of them and resisted the cold invasion.
Wang Xuenan immediately opened the Xuanwu Spiritual Umbrella, and the light cyan spiritual light surged, turning into an indestructible defensive barrier, covering the four gods, resisting the ice blades and cold air coming from all directions. The ice and ice vines hit the barrier, making a loud noise, and the spiritual light trembled, but it was always solid and unbreakable, and the defensive power of Xuanwu was fully demonstrated.
For a moment, in the valley, ice and holy fire collided, green vines and ice vines entangled, murderous aura and cold demonic power intertwined, the wind howled, the sky was filled with frost, the holy fire was blazing, and the spiritual light shone. An earth-shattering battle between good and evil completely broke out.
The white snake demon's figure is erratic, and it shuttles freely in the ice mist. There are endless ice-cold demon techniques. Sometimes it condenses the ice sword to chop, sometimes it breathes the cold mist and freezes, sometimes it controls the ice edge to attack. The moves are feminine and cruel, and the moves directly hit the vital points of the four gods. She has practiced for thousands of years, has deep demonic power, and has reached the pinnacle of control over ice spells.
